decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard display that sits squarely in our core paper-based display knowledge, we can keep learning from customer use and improve it with our in-house R&D rather than withdraw it.
The pegboard-back display remains closely related to our established design and production capabilities, so our absorptive capacity supports retention and incremental refinement.
This standard quarter-pallet cardboard display is highly compatible with our existing know-how and customer base, making portfolio consolidation less likely than continued use as a core offer.

The wooden display pallet is more weakly aligned with our paper-focused competence base, so the lower fit with our accumulated knowledge and development routines makes resource reallocation to core cardboard solutions more sensible.

Although technically close to our core offer, the media-specific quarter-pallet display is narrower in application, and we are more likely to fold what we learned from it into broader display development than keep it as a separate product.
